name: Bad Slime
storyline:
In BAD SLIME you will be pummeled, flattened and burned, and excitedly return again and again.

Throughout your journey to the top of this mega city, you will encounter a variety of hazards, creatures and challenging bosses - each with unique behaviors.

To battle these obstacles, you collect items that can dramatically, and often unpredictably, change your abilities and playstyle. Every combination creates new possibilities, encouraging you to experiment, adapt, and discover powerful and unexpected synergies.

Death is never the end. The further you progress with each run, the more the game evolves.
summary: Bad SLIME is a fast-paced action roguelite built on controls that forces you to either move or attack. Explore a fallen megacity and fight monsters, gather treasure and reveal secrets. Collect items that not only make you stronger - it changes what you are.
